title: Reset your password
body: If you forgot your password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and we will email you a reset link. The link works for one hour. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder or ask your account admin to send a new invitation.

title: Turn on two-factor authentication
body: Two-factor authentication adds a code from your phone to every sign-in. Open Settings, then Security, and choose Turn on 2FA. You can use an authenticator app or text messages.

title: Two-factor codes not arriving
body: Text message codes can take a few minutes. Check that your phone number is correct under Security. If codes still do not arrive, switch to an authenticator app or use one of your backup codes.

title: Sign in with Google or Microsoft
body: You can sign in with a Google or Microsoft account instead of a password. Choose the provider on the sign-in page. Your email address must match the one on your account.

title: Set up single sign-on (SSO)
body: Single sign-on lets your team sign in through your identity provider, such as Okta or Azure AD. SSO is available on the Business plan. An admin sets it up under Settings, then Security, then SSO.

title: Request a refund
body: We refund unused time on annual plans within 30 days of a charge. Monthly plans are not refunded, but you can cancel at any time. To ask for a refund, contact support with your invoice number.

title: Cancel your subscription
body: To cancel, open Billing and choose Cancel subscription. Your account stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Cancelling does not delete your data.

title: Change your billing email
body: Invoices and receipts go to the billing email. To change it, open Billing, then Billing details, and enter the new address. It can be different from your sign-in email.

title: Download invoices and receipts
body: Every invoice is in Billing, under Invoice history. Choose an invoice to download it as a PDF. Receipts are attached to the email we send when a payment goes through.

title: Add your VAT number to invoices
body: Businesses in the EU and UK can add a VAT number so it appears on every invoice. Open Billing, then Billing details, and enter it under Tax ID. It applies to invoices from the next charge.

title: Why was I charged twice?
body: A second charge is usually a pending authorisation that your bank releases within a few days. If both charges are still there after a week, contact support with the dates and amounts and we will refund the duplicate.

title: Upgrade or downgrade your plan
body: Change plans from Billing, then Plan. Upgrades start straight away and you pay the difference for the rest of the period. Downgrades start at your next renewal.

title: Pay by bank transfer
body: Annual Business plans can be paid by bank transfer. Ask support for a transfer invoice; our bank details are on it. Payments take three to five working days to clear.

title: Update your payment card
body: To change the card we charge, open Billing, then Payment method, and add the new card. The old card is removed once the new one is saved.

title: Export your data to CSV
body: You can export clients, invoices and expenses to CSV from Reports, then Export. Large exports are emailed to you as a download link when they are ready.

title: Import clients from a spreadsheet
body: Upload a CSV or Excel file under Clients, then Import. The first row must hold column names. Rows with no client name are skipped and listed in the import summary.

title: Connect your bank account
body: Connect a bank account under Banking to bring in transactions automatically. We support most UK and EU banks through open banking. The connection must be renewed every 90 days.

title: Bank feed stopped updating
body: Bank connections expire every 90 days. If your feed stopped, open Banking and choose Reconnect. If the bank is not listed, upload a statement file instead.

title: Set up webhooks
body: Webhooks send an event to your server when an invoice is created, paid or overdue. Add an endpoint URL under Settings, then Developers. Failed deliveries are retried for 24 hours.

title: API rate limits
body: The API allows 120 requests per minute for each account. A request over the limit gets status 429 with a Retry-After header. Contact support if you need a higher limit.

title: Add a team member
body: Admins can invite people from Settings, then Team. Each person gets an email invitation that is valid for seven days. Team members count as seats on your plan.

title: Roles and permissions
body: There are three roles: Admin, Accountant and Viewer. Admins manage billing and the team; Accountants can create and edit invoices; Viewers can only read. Change a role from Settings, then Team.

title: Remove a team member
body: Removing someone from Settings, then Team, signs them out and frees their seat. Their invoices and notes stay on the account.

title: Send invoice reminders automatically
body: Automatic reminders email your client when an invoice is due and again when it is overdue. Turn them on under Settings, then Reminders, and choose how many days apart they go.

title: Accept card payments on invoices
body: Connect a payment provider under Settings, then Payments, and clients can pay invoices by card from the invoice email. Fees are taken by the provider.

title: Invoice in another currency
body: Each client can have their own currency. Set it when you create the client, or on the client's page. Reports convert totals to your home currency at the day's rate.

title: Delete your account
body: An admin can delete the account from Settings, then Account. Deleting removes all data after 30 days and cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.

title: Use the mobile app
body: The mobile app for iPhone and Android lets you send invoices, snap receipts and see who has paid. Sign in with the same email and password as on the web.

title: Change the language of emails
body: Emails to your clients can be sent in English, French, German or Spanish. Set the language on each client's page; it applies to invoices, reminders and receipts.
